segments.comment: Independent display.c show_glyph() witness for its in_mklev suppression: a debug elven Priestess loads bigrm-5 with #wizloaddes, then loads soko1-2 from inside that lit room. premap_detect() runs during load_special() while in_mklev is set, so show_glyph() leaves the glyph buffer holding the bigroom; after level_finalize_topology() clears in_mklev, fill_special_room() -> fill_zoo() -> makemon() prints 'suddenly appears', and vpline()'s vision_recalc(0) and flush_screen() show only the cells whose sight changed over the stale bigroom until makemap_prepost()'s docrt().
